_comment: VoltPilot entity-type catalog (E1b) - the data-driven truth for known
entity types (contract edge-entity-config.md: the wire vocabulary is an
OPEN kebab-case pattern; THIS catalog is what the api validates entity
creation against). Adding a type is ADDITIVE: append an entry here (+ an
optional edge driver, which is E6 work) - never a schema release.
Served to the portal admin editor via GET /api/v1/admin/entity-type-catalog
and read by EntityTypeCatalog/EntityRegistryService, so client and server
validate against ONE truth (the flowcatalog precedent).
Fields: category steers the edge guard semantics (storage|producer|meter|
consumer - the Go core infers the same category from declared guards, so
the two never need a lockstep enum); controllable = may carry control=TRUE
measurement points (replaces the dropped control-only-battery DB CHECK);
composed = capabilities/guards are COMPOSED from v1 master data by the
bootstrap (battery asset / measurement points) and not directly creatable
or guard-editable through the admin entity CRUD.
capabilities and guard config; a rated power (maxPowerKw) bounds the
numeric commands and lands as guards.limits.max_consumption_kw.

types.certification_notes: Nur am OCPP-Simulator nachgewiesen (internal/ocppsim + das Rig): Budget wird an den simulierten Zaehlerwerten gehalten, der Ausfall faellt auf das hinterlegte Sicherheitsprofil zurueck. Der Flip auf zertifiziert braucht EINE beaufsichtigte Bench-Session je Saeulen-TYP (CONTROL-BENCH.md, die Deye-/go-e-Disziplin): nimmt die Firmware Profile an UND um, wirkt der duration-Ablauf, ueberlebt das Profil einen Neustart, akzeptiert sie Grenzen in Watt.
